id.description: The preset's slug and name: the Library writes both into every resolution preset it creates.

layerOrder.description: Default ["project", "company", "global"]: first layer with a match wins.

autoAcceptAbove.description: Above this: accept and log. Default 1 (never auto-accept).

suggestAbove.description: Above this: ask with the suggestion pre-selected. Below: ask without one.

ai.description: AI suggestions for names no entry matches.

unresolved.description: What to do with a name nothing resolves.

askFor.description: Which unresolved names are worth a question. Others keep their raw text (rules can still match raw names). A door's type name rarely needs a term; a wall's usually does. Default: every field, always.

contradictionWarnPct.description: Reported quantity vs geometry (measure): a stated volume, area or thickness differing from the geometry by more than this percentage raises a `contradiction` question. Default 10.

contradictionBlockPct.description: Above this percentage a `contradiction` question blocks the BoQ ("needs input"), unless the stated value is an exporter unit error (the geometry is then used and the question stays optional). Default 50; never below `contradictionWarnPct`.

plausibility.description: Plausibility warnings (review A-07): never a number, never blocking. `maxSlabThickness` (m, default 1.5): a slab thicker than this; `storeySlabAreaFactor` (default 3): a storey whose floor slabs exceed this times the footprint; `slabNameWords`: whole words in a slab's name or type that say it is something else (default: pile, pad and cap in several languages, `engine/ifc_boq/plausibility.py`; an empty list turns the check off).

DictField.description: Which raw field an entry or extractor reads.

Expr.description:
A formula in the small, safe expression language.

Grammar (evaluated only by the engine, never by `eval`):   literals      12  0.5  "text"  true  false   ("text": any characters as written, "béton" included;                 the only escapes are \"  \\  \n  \t  \uXXXX)   operators     + - * /  ( )  = != > >= < <=  AND OR NOT   functions     IF(c,a,b)  MIN(a,b,..)  MAX(a,b,..)  ROUND(x,step)  CEIL(x,step)                 FLOOR(x,step)  ABS(x)  SQRT(x)  PI()  COALESCE(a,b,..)                 UNDER(term, "concrete")   true if a dictionary term is that term or beneath it   variables     any MeasuredField           e.g. net_area, thickness, length                 props["Pset_WallCommon.FireRating"]                 p.<param>                   e.g. p.opening_threshold                 building.<field>            whole-building values (BuildingMeasures), e.g. building.gross_volume                 src.<field> / src.qty       (derived rules only: the source element / line)   aggregates    SUM | COUNT | MIN | MAX | AVG over a collection, with optional WHERE:                   SUM(openings.area WHERE area > p.opening_threshold)                   SUM(layers.volume WHERE material = "concrete")                   COUNT(openings WHERE kind = "door")                   SUM(faces.net_area WHERE side = "a")                 collections: openings, layers, faces, children
